Overview of Aargau Region (Aargau)

Aargau Region (Aargau) is located in the Aargau region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Baden. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionAargau
Capital cityBaden
Cities & municipalities69
Primary transport hubBaden Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Aargau Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Aargau

When visiting cities across Aargau, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Aargau

Best time to visit Aargau: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
